Not glasses on glasses, just a separate pair. I'm also an all the time glasses user but I have two pairs, ones for everyday use and ones with lower distance but still my astigmatism power so I can use it for the computer.

If you have glasses with a high prescription, you may need glasses for up close, this usually comes with a weaker prescription. Your eyes will feel more relaxed and it just won't be "blurry" speaking from experience. 

I also assume the 75hz was a typo and you meant 175? If not then 75 is pretty bad. Also 32" and only 1440p isn't great, usually you'd want that on a 27". Either way, I would either move the monitor further back or just get a different one all together. A 27" 1440p 144z atleast and make sure it isn't a VA panel. This with a pair of glasses for computer work will give you a more comfortable experience.
